description: Inventario Fotográfico de la Red Vial Departamental - Valle del Cauca is a dataset listed in Colombian national open data portal (datos.gov.co), an open data portal (Socrata), published or maintained by Gobernación de Valle del Cauca, Valle del Cauca. Contiene los puntos que almacenan fotografías cada 100 metros de la red vial departamental del Valle del Cauca. Coverage: Gobernación de Valle del Cauca, Valle del Cauca. The portal files it under the publisher Gobernación de Valle del Cauca, Valle del Cauca. Its tags are infraestructura vial, red vial. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal files it under the category Ordenamiento Territorial. The portal shows 2025-05-28 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datos-gov-co-portal.
